newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Teledata tops quiet ADR mkt.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Teledata tops quiet ADR mkt.

text.p: Israel's Teledata Communications Ltd fell Tuesday to stand out in a quiet American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) market ahead of a meeting to set U.S. interest rates.
Traders said volume was light and trading featureless ahead of the rate-setting meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee. The panel is scheduled to announce its decision at 1415 EDT/1815 GMT.
"It's very, very quiet. Everybody is on hold waiting for the Fed," a trader said.

Teledata fell 1/4 to 26-1/2 after it said it priced a public offering of 2.76 million shares at $26 each. The telecommunication equipment maker said 1.1 million shares were being offered by it and the rest by some shareholders.
Volume in mid-morning was 597,100 shares, more than six times normal daily volume. The ADRs were the most active among the 814-strong ADR group.
Among European ADRs, British banking group Barclays Plc fell 2-3/4 to 79 amid profit-taking.

Swedish drug company Astra rose 1-7/8 to 44-1/8 after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration updated Astra's patents for an anti-ulcer drug. Swedish telecommunications equipment maker Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson was unchanged at 35.
Among Latin American ADRs, Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA fell one to 123-1/4.
Decliners led advancers 238 to 167. The ADR group eased 0.02 percent and volume was 16.5 million shares.
